_meta.description: Dynamic UX audit rules engine. Add/update/deprecate rules without touching the audit script. Any agent can add rules by appending to the 'rules' array.
_meta.how_to_add_rules: Append to the 'rules' array. Each rule needs: id, category, severity, check_type, and either 'threshold', 'pattern', or 'manual_check'. Run ./scripts/ux-preflight-audit.sh --validate to verify rule syntax.

cognitive_load.name: Cognitive Load
cognitive_load.description: Miller's Law, Hick's Law, information density

design_system.name: Design System Compliance
design_system.description: Token usage, component reuse, visual consistency

touch_targets.name: Touch & Interaction
touch_targets.description: Sizing, spacing, feedback for all interactive elements

performance.name: Speed & Performance
performance.description: Load times, bundle sizes, perceived performance

thresholds._comment: Centralized thresholds referenced by rules. Update here, all rules update automatically.

rules.name: Tab count within limits
rules.description: Maximum 5 tabs visible at once (ideally 3-4). More causes decision paralysis.
rules.source: Progressive Disclosure research, MCC UX Analysis (C+ grade, 11 tabs)

rules.name: Nav items within limits
rules.description: Mobile: 3-5 items, Desktop: 5-7. Sidebar: 5-9 with grouping.
rules.source: Navigation Patterns research, Hick's Law

rules.name: Clear visual hierarchy
rules.description: Can you identify the most important element in <3 seconds without reading text?
rules.manual_check: Look at the page. What's the first thing your eye goes to? Is it the primary action?
rules.source: Core UX Principles, Cognitive Load research

rules.name: Smart defaults reduce decisions
rules.description: Pre-fill fields, select most common option, auto-detect context. Every decision in field mode is a design failure.
rules.manual_check: Count the decisions a user must make to complete the primary action. Target: <5 decisions.
rules.source: Core UX Principles, Master UX Improvement Plan

rules.name: One primary action per screen
rules.description: Visual hierarchy guides the eye to a single most important thing.
rules.manual_check: Squint at the page. Does one element stand out? If multiple compete, fix hierarchy.
rules.source: Master UX Improvement Plan, Cognitive Load research

rules.name: Design system CSS linked
rules.description: Every web_app page must import tiny-seed-design-system.css
rules.source: Visual Design Audit (52% adoption)

rules.name: No non-standard green hex values
rules.description: Primary green must be #22c55e or var(--ts-green-500). Not #4A7C43, #2d5a27, #3a8f35.
rules.source: Visual Design Audit (7 different greens across codebase)

rules.name: CSS variables used for colors
rules.description: Colors should use var(--token) references, not raw hex values outside :root.
rules.source: Visual Design Audit, Style Guide

rules.name: data-theme attribute set
rules.description: Every page must declare data-theme='dark' or 'light' on html or body element.
rules.source: Visual Design Audit (customer.html uses wrong theme)

rules.name: Excessive raw hex colors
rules.description: More than 20 raw hex values outside :root indicates poor token adoption.
rules.source: Visual Design Audit (38/100 consistency score)

rules.name: Advanced options hidden by default
rules.description: Optional/advanced features behind accordions, 'More options', or secondary tabs.
rules.manual_check: Count visible elements above the fold. If >12 interactive elements, hide the least-used behind a disclosure pattern.
rules.source: Progressive Disclosure research (4-level framework)

rules.name: No more than 2 clicks for common tasks
rules.description: The most frequent user action should be achievable in 1-2 interactions.
rules.manual_check: Identify the #1 task users do on this page. Count clicks/taps from landing to completion.
rules.source: Progressive Disclosure research, Master UX Improvement Plan

rules.name: Empty states defined
rules.description: Every data section needs an encouraging empty state with a call-to-action.
rules.source: Core UX Principles (no blank screens), Competitor Insights

rules.name: No touch targets below 44px
rules.description: All interactive elements must be at least 44x44px (Apple HIG minimum).
rules.source: Mobile Farm UX Research, Style Guide, Core UX Principles

rules.name: Active state feedback
rules.description: All buttons must have :active CSS feedback (transform: scale(0.98) or similar).
rules.source: Speed & Performance research, Style Guide

rules.name: touch-action CSS for mobile
rules.description: Add touch-action: manipulation to prevent 300ms tap delay on mobile.
rules.source: Mobile UX Audit

rules.name: Skeleton screens over spinners
rules.description: Use skeleton loading (gray placeholders) instead of spinning indicators.
rules.source: Speed & Performance research (perceived speed)

rules.name: Optimistic UI updates
rules.description: UI should update immediately on user action, sync in background, rollback if fails.
rules.manual_check: For each form submission or state change: does the UI wait for the server response, or update immediately?
rules.source: Speed & Performance research (Linear's strategy)

rules.name: Viewport meta tag present
rules.description: Every page must have <meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1'>
rules.source: Mobile UX Audit

rules.name: Input font 16px+ (iOS zoom prevention)
rules.description: Input font-size below 16px causes iOS to auto-zoom on focus, breaking layout.
rules.source: Mobile UX Audit, Mobile App Vision

rules.name: Bottom navigation on mobile
rules.description: Mobile should use bottom tab bar (4 items max), not hamburger menu as primary nav.
rules.manual_check: At 375px width, is navigation in the bottom thumb zone? Is it a tab bar with <=4 items?
rules.source: Navigation Patterns, Mobile Farm UX Research

rules.name: Safe area insets for notched devices
rules.description: Fixed-position elements must use env(safe-area-inset-*) to avoid notch overlap.
rules.source: Mobile UX Audit, Style Guide

rules.name: ARIA labels present
rules.description: Interactive elements (especially icon-only buttons) must have aria-label.
rules.source: SEO Dashboard UX Audit, Mobile App Vision

rules.name: Images have alt attributes
rules.description: All tags need alt text. Decorative images use alt=''.
rules.source: Mobile App Vision (ADA 2026 compliance)

rules.name: Translation support (data-i18n)
rules.description: Translatable text should use data-i18n for bilingual workforce (English + Spanish).
rules.source: Style Guide (bilingual workforce requirement)

rules.name: Plain English labels
rules.description: No code-style labels or jargon. 'Sow in greenhouse' not 'ghsow'. 'Export CSV' not 'Submit'.
rules.manual_check: Read every visible label. Would a farmer understand each one without technical knowledge?
rules.source: Core UX Principles (Explain Everything), index.html fix (typeLabels map)

rules.name: Encouraging empty states
rules.description: Empty states should guide action: 'Ready to start? [Button]' not 'No data found.'
rules.manual_check: Find every empty state. Does it have: icon + encouraging text + action button?
rules.source: SEO Dashboard UX Audit, Competitor Insights (empty states matter)

rules.name: Error messages are helpful
rules.description: 'That didn't work. Try [alternative]?' not 'Error 500' or generic 'Failed'.
rules.manual_check: Trigger each error state. Does the message explain what happened AND what to do next?
rules.source: Character Design research (error tone guidelines)

rules.name: Field mode considerations
rules.description: If this page is used outdoors: 60px+ targets, 18px+ text, high contrast, max 2 taps.
rules.manual_check: Will this page be used in the field? If yes, verify field mode thresholds. If unknown, design for both.
rules.source: Master UX Improvement Plan, Mobile Farm UX Research

rules.name: Office mode keyboard shortcuts
rules.description: Desktop pages should support Cmd+K (palette), keyboard navigation, and common shortcuts.
rules.manual_check: Can the primary action be completed without a mouse? Is there a command palette?
rules.source: Master UX Improvement Plan, Competitor Insights (Linear keyboard-first)

rules.name: Progress and celebration
rules.description: Show progress toward goals. Celebrate completions (30% of the time, not every time).
rules.manual_check: After completing the primary action, does the user see any positive feedback?
rules.source: SEO Dashboard UX Audit (40/100 habit formation), Core UX Principles

rules.name: AI character is ambient, not intrusive
rules.description: AI should be present when needed, quiet during focus. Max 2 nudges visible, 5s auto-dismiss.
rules.manual_check: Does any AI element block the primary task? Can all AI suggestions be dismissed with one action?
rules.source: Character Design research (Stanford CASA)

rules.name: No hardcoded API URLs
rules.description: All API calls must use api-config.js. No inline script.google.com URLs.
rules.source: CLAUDE.md API rules, UX Audit Report
